## 2. Governed Ventures & Corporate Hierarchy
1. **NSK Groups** (Parent Holding Conglomerate)
   - URL: https://nskgroups.website
   - Description: Technology holding company governing high-impact subsidiaries in IT infrastructure, artificial intelligence, and frontier deep-tech.

2. **NiTechSpark** (IT Infrastructure, DevOps & Cybersecurity)
   - URL: https://nitechspark.site
   - Core Services: Linux server administration (Ubuntu, Debian, Kali), cloud scale DevOps, Prometheus & Grafana observability, zero-trust security auditing, and DPDP Act 2023 compliance automation.

3. **NiteHire** (Autonomous AI Recruitment ATS)
   - URL: https://nitehire.site
   - Core Features: Next-generation AI talent screening platform featuring 2-level automated interviews (voice communication + technical resume-based scoring), HR Kanban pipelines, and candidate coaching.

4. **NiteOrbit** (Space Tech & Ground Systems)
   - URL: https://niteorbit.space
   - Focus: Space Ground Systems DevOps, satellite telemetry operations, and orbital cybersecurity infrastructure.

## 3. Key Proprietary Software Applications
- **PropoTrack** (https://tracker.nitechspark.site): Corporate proposal tracking and contract workflow coordinator.
- **NiteSentinel (SecureScope)**: AI-driven endpoint security auditor mapping compliance to DPDP Act 2023, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
- **sparkAudit** (https://sparkaudit.nitechspark.site): Automated GRC evidence collector and NIST security sync.
- **CyberScan** (https://cyberscan.nitechspark.site): Asynchronous network port scanner and SSL certificate expiry monitor.
- **RCA Engine**: AI incident root cause diagnostic system with n8n workflow automation.
- **Alone AI (NiteBuddy)** (https://nitebuddy.nskgroups.website): Vector-memory AI companion with emotional intelligence and Qdrant memory.
- **SustainHub** (https://sustainhub.nskgroups.website): Corporate ESG telemetry and sustainability metrics portal.
- **SENTRIYA**: Mission-critical emergency safety ecosystem with real-time encrypted SOS capture.
- **NSK Connect**: Secure C-Suite incident response Android application built with Jetpack Compose.
